name: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars

accessibility.description: Voice of Cards Access speaks menus, story cards, battles, shops and the card game through a screen reader. A board scanner lists exits, people, shops, chests and other items nearest first, each with the walk to reach it, such as 2 left, 1 up. Keys report your current card and its neighbours, the objective, battle units, hit points, gems, gold, your hand, the pot and scores. It works with a keyboard or an Xbox gamepad and has in-game help. It speaks English or French following the game's language, and the game master's lines are read only while subtitles are on. Tested with NVDA only.
